content:
The divisor-count condition is
\[
(2a+3)(2b+3)\prod_i(2c_i+1)=51.
\]
All factors are odd and at least \(3\), so since \(51=3\cdot 17\), the only possibilities are
\[
(2a+3,2b+3)=(3,17)\quad\text{or}\quad(17,3),
\]
with \(k=1\). Thus
\[
n=3^7 \quad \text{or} \quad n=2^7.
\]
In either case, \(5n\) has divisor count
\[
(7+1)(1+1)=16.
\]
\[
\boxed{16}
\]
